children: HONG KONG, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Star Plus Legend Holdings Limited ("Star Plus Legend", stock code: 6683.HK) and Galaxy Corporation Co., Ltd ("Galaxy") signed a strategic cooperation memorandum of understanding (MOU) in Hong Kong on November 16. Building on their existing collaboration in concerts, exhibitions, artist IP and derivative products, the two parties will expand into global robot entertainment and AI robotics, focusing on robot parks, robot tours, and the joint development of AI trendy toys and companion robots for the Chinese, Korean and global markets.
The signing ceremony featured a robot fashion show and dance performance jointly presented by the two parties and UNITREE, set to classic BIGBANG tracks.

Founded in 2019, Galaxy is a Korean entertainment-technology company whose artists include G-DRAGON (Kwon Ji-Yong), Song Kang-ho, Kim Jong-kook and Lee Tae-min. It operates Galaxy Robot Park in Seoul, the world's first embodied AI-themed space, and has launched Galaxy Robot Arena Dubai.

Founded in 2017 and listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in July 2023, Star Plus Legend focuses on IP creation and operation. Known as the "Jay Chou concept stock", it has developed the CHOUCHOU IP around Jay Chou and produced his first outdoor reality show, J-Style Trip, which has aired for three seasons. The Company has also partnered with UNITREE to develop consumer-grade robots with strong IP attributes.

In November 2025, Star Plus Legend subscribed, through an industrial fund, for no more than 7% of Galaxy's issued share capital, becoming a strategic shareholder. The cooperation initially covered concerts featuring Galaxy artists, large-scale themed exhibitions, and artist IP and derivative products. The new MOU builds on this relationship, extending cooperation into AI- and embodied AI-driven product and scenario development.
Early Proof Points: Two Embodied AI Entertainment Scenarios Already Up and Running

In November 2026, Star Plus Legend opened the world's first Pandabot Cafe in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong. Combining embodied AI, AIGC and leading IPs, the cafe brings interactive, physical IP experiences into everyday consumer spaces. Galaxy Robot Park, meanwhile, offers venue-based robot performances and interactions. The two initiatives demonstrate embodied AI entertainment in both everyday consumer and venue settings.
Strategic Alignment: Two Statements, One Direction

Galaxy CEO Choi Yong-ho describes the company's roadmap as "today, tomorrow and the day after": IP and content today, AI and robotics tomorrow, and aerospace in the longer term. Star Plus Legend shares this outlook, viewing AI as "the next stop for IP". Star Plus Legend CFO Lai Kwok Fai Franki has also said that AI and embodied robots represent the next stage for IP, addressing the need for IP to be "present and responding". Both companies see AI and robotics as a way to bring IP beyond screens and enable interaction with audiences.

Star Plus Legend brings full-chain IP operating experience, supported by China's mature supply chain and manufacturing and mass-production capabilities in AI and embodied AI hardware. Galaxy contributes content creativity and experience in operating robot performances. Under the MOU, robot parks will serve as experience platforms, robot tours as content output, and AI trendy toys and companion robots as ways to extend interaction into daily life—from "presence" to "companionship".

The two parties aim to combine industrial manufacturing capabilities with creative content to expand the integration of IP and robotics and deliver new entertainment-technology experiences to consumers in China, Korea and beyond.
